title: PrikBoard theme
description: A color theme for PrikBoard. Tokens are the CSS custom properties the app is drawn with (written without the leading --). A theme names a built-in theme in `extends` and lists only what it changes, or leaves `extends` out and lists every token. Values are plain CSS: colors, shadows or font families, never url(...) or other rules. See docs/themes.md.

format.description: The version of this file format.

id.description: A short id, lower case letters, digits and dashes. Stored per browser as the chosen theme, so keep it once people use the theme.

name.description: The name shown in the theme picker.

description.description: One line about the theme, shown with its name.

colorScheme.description: Whether the page is dark or light: sets the browser's own controls (form fields, scroll bars) to match.

extends.description: The id of a built-in theme (productivity, positivity) whose tokens this one starts from.

fonts.description: Google Fonts families the font tokens use, as in a fonts.googleapis.com css2 link ("Nunito:wght@400;500;600;700"). Loaded from Google Fonts when the theme is picked, as Geist is. A theme that extends another keeps its fonts unless it lists its own.

bar.description: Tokens that change on the top bar and the phone layout's bars, for a bar whose color differs from the page (Positivity's navy bars on a light page). Menus opened from a bar take the page's tokens again.

colorScheme.description: Whether the bars are dark or light.

color.description: A CSS color, or var(--token) naming another token.

bar.description: The top bar and the phone layout's bars.

bar-line.description: The line under the top bar.

panel.description: Floating panels: the tool rail, minimap, zoom controls, menus.

panel-2.description: A panel inside a panel (fields, rows).

dialog.description: Dialogs and windows (the expanded card, sheets).

line.description: Edges of panels, buckets and fields.

line-strong.description: Edges that need to stand out more (hovered fields, dividers).

text-2.description: Secondary text: labels, values on panels.

text-body.description: Running text, such as a text component's Markdown.

muted.description: Muted text and icons: bucket names, counts, inactive tools.

subtle.description: The faintest text: hints, placeholders, captions.

hover.description: Background of a hovered button or menu item.

tool-hover.description: Background of a hovered tool on the rail.

row-hover.description: Background of a hovered row in a list.

accent.description: The accent: selection outlines, the pressed tool, primary buttons, links.

accent-ink.description: Text and icons on an accent background.

accent-bg.description: A soft accent background: the pressed tool, chosen items.

danger.description: Text and icons for deleting and errors.

bucket-bg.description: A bucket in lists (the phone layout).

bucket-fill.description: A bucket on the board. Keep it nearly opaque, so a bucket over another covers it.

bucket-dot.description: The dot grid inside a bucket.

dot.description: The dot grid on the board.

mini-dot.description: The dots in small board previews.

chip.description: Background of counts and small chips.

dim.description: The veil over the page behind a dialog. Use a translucent color.

slot.description: Empty slots and drop places, such as the dashed avatar slot.

halo.description: The ring around an agent at work.

float-shadow.description: Shadow of floating panels (the rail, minimap, menus).

scrollbar-track.description: Scroll bar tracks on the canvases.

window-shadow.description: Shadow of windows over the board (the expanded card).

avatar-more-bg.description: Background of the +N avatar for more people.

agent-bg.description: Background of agents' avatars, chips and badges.

agent-text.description: Text and icons on agents' avatars, chips and badges.

discord-bg.description: Background of a connected Discord server's badge.

discord-text.description: Text of a connected Discord server's badge.

tone-butter.description: Butter as text or an icon on a panel (the card tool). Make it deeper than the fill on a light theme.

tone-mint.description: Mint as text or an icon on a panel.

tone-sky.description: Sky as text or an icon on a panel.

tone-coral.description: Coral as text or an icon on a panel.

tone-lilac.description: Lilac as text or an icon on a panel.

ghost-bg.description: A ghost button's own background; transparent where its outline shows well enough.

ink-chalk.description: The Chalk pen: light on a dark board, dark on a light one.

ink-ink.description: The Ink pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

ink-ochre.description: The Ochre pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

ink-pine.description: The Pine pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

ink-ocean.description: The Ocean pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

ink-brick.description: The Brick pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

ink-violet.description: The Violet pen, for drawing over a card's fill.

font.description: The font family of all text: one the page loads (Geist, Geist Mono, or one in `fonts`) or the device has.

mono.description: The monospace font family: tags, counts, readable ids.
